svg.title: Nest — six circular Stellar-inspired logo variations
svg.desc: A Twin cut, B Stellar ring, C Compact weave, D Soft cradle, E Ivory core, F Single cut. All retain a circular egg and Nest orange palette.

svg.title: Nest — Circular cut
svg.desc: The original woven orange Nest cradle holds a round seed with two rising diagonal negative-space cuts inspired by Stellar.

svg.title: Nest — Circular orbit
svg.desc: The original woven orange Nest cradle holds a circular ring with a pair of rising diagonal bars inspired by Stellar. All core geometry stays inside the round silhouette.

svg.title: Nest — Compact Stellar
svg.desc: Three broad orange woven ribbons cradle a circular seed with two rising diagonal transparent cuts inspired by Stellar.

svg.title: Nest — Rounded Cradle
svg.desc: A compact two-band orange cradle holds a circular outlined seed crossed by a diagonal orange band. The egg remains fully round.

svg.title: Nest — Ivory core
svg.desc: A cream circular egg with internal orange diagonal bands, cradled by the original orange weave.

svg.title: Nest — Single cut
svg.desc: A solid round egg with one bold rising diagonal cut, held by the original weave.
